title: Largest Lakes of the World
intro: Ten questions on the biggest and deepest lakes of the world. Every answer shows its source.

questions.prompt: Which of these lakes has the largest surface area?
questions.explain: Lake Superior covers about 82,078 km2 on the Natural Earth outline, more than Lake Victoria (67,332 km2).

questions.prompt: Which is the largest lake in Africa?
questions.explain: Lake Victoria covers about 67,332 km2; Lake Tanganyika, the next, covers 32,897 km2.

questions.prompt: Which of these lakes has the largest area?
questions.explain: Lake Ladoga in Russia covers about 17,564 km2, Lake Onega 9,889 km2, Lake Saimaa 9,309 km2 and Vänern in Sweden 5,722 km2.

questions.prompt: Which of these Canadian lakes is the largest by area?
questions.explain: Great Bear Lake covers about 30,656 km2, ahead of Great Slave Lake (25,941 km2) and Lake Winnipeg (24,693 km2).

questions.prompt: Which of these lakes is the deepest?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Lake Baikal a maximum depth of 1,642 m, against 406 m for Lake Superior.

questions.prompt: Which of these African lakes is the deepest?
questions.explain: Lake Malawi reaches 704 m; Lake Victoria is only 83 m deep.

questions.prompt: Which large lake is shared by Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda?
questions.explain: Lake Victoria's shore lies in Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda; Lake Tanganyika touches Burundi, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Tanzania and Zambia.

questions.prompt: Which of the Great Lakes lies entirely in the United States?
questions.explain: Lake Superior, Lake Huron and Lake Ontario are shared with Canada; Lake Michigan lies wholly in the United States.

questions.prompt: Lake Titicaca lies on the border of which two countries?
questions.explain: Lake Titicaca in the Andes is shared by Bolivia and Peru.

questions.prompt: Which of these is a man-made reservoir rather than a natural lake?
questions.explain: Natural Earth tags Lake Volta (Ghana and Togo) as a reservoir; Lake Victoria, Lake Malawi and Lake Turkana are natural lakes.
